purpose: Supply this file together with a source book PDF. Generated output must follow this contract exactly.

field_rules.title: Use the printed heading where present. Use a concise inferred heading only when necessary.
field_rules.kind: Must be one of allowed_kinds. Inferred internal divisions normally use section.
field_rules.printed_start: Arabic pages are integers; Roman pages are lowercase strings; null only when unresolved.
field_rules.physical_start: One-based physical page number in the PDF.
field_rules.pdf_index: Zero-based PDF index; must equal physical_start minus 1.

normalization_rules: Convert Arabic page strings such as "27" to integer 27.
Convert Roman labels such as "IX" to lowercase "ix".
Use section for inferred internal divisions.
Do not encode uncertainty by changing kind.
generation_instructions: Identify front matter, chapters, sections, subsections, appendices, bibliography, notes, captions, and index.
Record printed_start, physical_start, and pdf_index for every retained node.
Return one valid JSON document containing only the outline list and supported row keys.
